policy.whenMottyInFixture: Attach exactly one preview vegan one-liner as sentence 2.
selection: Tag preview fixture: fav/dog/coin from win probs; waiver_in; projected_high/low; model_likes/hates; vs_andrew; titanic_context; trade_heavy; squeaker_proj/blowout_proj; etc.
Score matching tags; hard-skip fav lines if he's the dog and vice versa.
Cooldown 6 GWs; no season repeat while alternatives remain.
Preview blurbs are shorter than recap — voice line must be one short sentence.
policy.tone: mates taking the piss — affectionate, forward-looking, never cruel

eventTaggers.waiver_in: has claim in latest waiver window in projected XI or roster
eventTaggers.projected_high: projectedPts >= league median projected + 8 or model fav strongly
eventTaggers.dud_risk: starter with high price/xP but flagged risk / low form
eventTaggers.rivalry_lite: any named rivalry week involving Motty (rare)
